name: sollarity
description: A website that provides insights and analysis about Solana-based meme coins, helping users identify legitimate investment opportunities and avoid scams.

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.test: cd server && npm test && cd ../client && npm test
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build

author: Sollarity Team
